redEvidence.summary: The initial plan fixture run failed because the new active task was not isolated; product contract tests then failed until model authorship, route observations, and selected-provider consistency were implemented.
Review found evaluator repetitions were being conflated with router attempts and that failed runs could not retain failed route observations; both were corrected before this candidate.

acceptanceResults.summary: Catalog modelAuthor and reviewed routePolicy are separate strict fields.
Shortlists carry strict provider routing plus opt-in router-metadata request configuration.
Complete runs require per-request reconciled attempts and one matching selected provider; failed runs may preserve failed attempts with no selection.
Scan results reconcile file, observation, confidence, patchability, and reason-code units within an explicit supported scope.
V1-06, V1-07, V1-09, and V1-10 preserve route and assessment evidence without adding runtime discovery.

residualRisks: OpenRouter router metadata is provider-supplied untrusted input and remains subject to adapter parsing in V1-06.
Live provider transport and cache behavior remain outside this offline correction task.
